liberdade.texto: Talk about, show, criticize, stream, review and spoil everything you get. No script, no approval, no minimum views, no deadline.

ficha.descricao: Illusion Fight is a free action universe created by Isaias Leal: books, a webtoon, games and an original soundtrack, all connected at illusionfight.com, in English, Portuguese and Spanish. The demo is on Steam and the universe is part of Steam Next Fest, October 19–26. Season 1 launches November 15, 2026.

o_que_e.r: An action universe created by Isaias Leal. It started as a book and grew into a webtoon, games and a soundtrack, all connected on the site. There are three universes: Illusion Fight, The Shadow World and Sea of Ashes.

ano_todo.p: How long is the area available?
ano_todo.r: All year. All of Season 1 stays unlocked for you, and the area keeps getting new chapters, art and content ideas. Come back whenever you want.

hiato.p: Will there be breaks between releases?
hiato.r: Yes. After every three months of releases there's a rest month. That month brings The Shadow World and Sea of Ashes, extra stories by the same author. So there's never a gap in content.

gratis.p: Is it free for my audience?
gratis.r: Yes. The games and most of the stories are free. There's an optional subscription that unlocks chapters earlier. You get that early access at no cost.

posso_falar.p: Can I say bad things about it?
posso_falar.r: Yes. Criticism is content. Nobody approves anything beforehand and there's no script.

republicar.r: Repost full content: a whole chapter, a whole webtoon episode or the original files. Excerpts, screenshots and up to 3 pages per post are fine.

prazo.p: How long do I have access?
prazo.r: The time shows at the top of your table. It depends on your channel size, from 1 to 6 months. It can be renewed.

idiomas.r: English, Portuguese and Spanish. Switch the language in the site menu and all the content follows.

lancamento.r: Season 1 launches November 15, 2026. Before that, the universe is in Steam Next Fest, October 19–26.

steam.r: The Season 1 page (app 1876210) and the free demo (app 5188520). Adding it to your wishlist helps the project a lot.

contato.p: How do I reach the author?
contato.r: Write to lutasdeilusao@gmail.com. Interviews, questions, a request for specific art: just ask.

temas.ano_todo: This area stays live all year, with all of Season 1 unlocked for you, and it keeps getting updated. If now isn't the time to record, come back later: there'll be something new waiting.

autor.fala: Isaias Leal spent almost 10 years in the games industry, worked on FNAF: Into the Pit and God of War: Sons of Sparta, and shipped over 50 titles. He left to build, on his own, a universe he's been writing since he was 17. Great for behind-the-scenes, career and indie dev channels, and for anyone who likes stories about people who bet everything on one project.

personagens.fala: Each main character has a past told separately: Nina, adopted at 3; Jack, on his own from a very young age, making bike deliveries to get by. Good for analysis, theories and "who's who" videos before reading.

contos.fala: If you want a self-contained story, pick a tale. Alan, the Champion shows Marelia's organized crime. Sonata of a Fight is short and direct. The Chains explains Kim's power. All of them are open now.

principal.fala: The main line is Illusion Fight: Kim, Jack and Nina in a world where fights happen in a simulator and the pain is real. You get 12 book chapters and every webtoon chapter finished before launch. Great for read-alongs and first impressions.

temporada.fala: Season 1 starts November 15, 2026, with chapters releasing in sequence. After every three months of releases there's a one-month hiatus, the rest month. That month brings extra content from the same author: The Shadow World and Sea of Ashes. That's why they live next to the main line: there's always a new story, and you have something to cover all year.

games.fala: Three complete, free browser games: LDI Gangues (gang brawls across the city), Lendas do LDI (your Vein changes the story) and Top Trumps with an online mode. Good for gameplay, audience challenges and Steam Next Fest coverage.

musica.fala: The universe has an original soundtrack playing on Radio Nina inside the site. There's also a whole tale about Kim and Jack's band. Works for music channels, soundtrack reacts and streams with background music.

universo.fala: Three universes by the same author: Illusion Fight (action), The Shadow World (horror) and Sea of Ashes (dark fantasy). Good for lore, comparison and worldbuilding videos.
